answer: Sealed Compute Attestation: each identity must complete a fixed workload on hardware it cannot parallelize (e.g. a serial memory-hard function) whose result a summit of validators re-executes and checks. At the wharf, agents submit the output, not the input. A whisper of collusion fails re-execution. Cost: attacker pays full compute per identity, rent-free sybils die because serial work cannot be batched or shared across keys.
